name: Váchartyán (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Váchartyán (a crowned white shield with a green plant and a red heart within a yellow frame) above a yellow scroll inscribed VÁCHARTYÁN.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Váchartyán arms with crown, frame and scroll
